verdicts.reason: A is a sensible split layout: copy card on the left, book on the right, terrazzo kept. But the '24 HOURS' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, the logo is shrunk to a speck in the bottom corner, the fine print is tiny, and the card nearly touches the left edge. B puts the CTA above the headline, which breaks reading order. It also loses almost all the terrazzo, leaves 'night.' orphaned on its own line, shrinks the logo to a speck and leaves a dead band at the bottom.

B has the CTA above the headline, loses the terrazzo, leaves 'night.' orphaned and has an empty lower third.
